admission.justification: Weighed condensed-plus-legacy audit compatibility, timestamping and local-verification designs and constrains downstream validator, triage CLI and site banner schemas.

alternatives.option: Support both condensed (root Challenge.lean with 5 challenge sorrys, root comparator.json with enable_nanoda/definition_names, optional comparator/ and verification/, nullable verification-note digests) and legacy (src/Challenge.lean + comparator/FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean with 7 challenge sorrys) layouts while hard-coding build_status='unverified-locally' and omitting all wall-clock timestamps.
alternatives.reason: Tracks live condensed main@41c2716658c4 cleanly without breaking legacy fixture compatibility, fails closed on ambiguous challenge files or partial verification/ directories, keeps epistemic status honest when Lean is not executed, and guarantees deterministic byte-identical regeneration for git diff --exit-code audit/.

alternatives.option: Drop legacy comparator/ and verification/ support entirely, or emit wall-clock generation timestamps or an invented local kernel-receipt format.
alternatives.reason: Breaks reproducibility against archived alpoge@c900e67c2 and legacy fixtures when comparator/ is re-integrated upstream, breaks deterministic regeneration on every run, and risks overstating verification status without an executed Lean kernel check.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A future approved requirement retires legacy-layout compatibility or replaces byte-identical committed audit snapshots with signed timestamped build receipts.

alternatives.option: Execute Lake/Lean locally during Phase 0 auditing to emit build_status='verified' with kernel-check receipts.
alternatives.reason: Out of scope for Phase 0 deterministic metadata/static-scan auditing, which must run without executing Lean or mutating upstream checkouts.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A future approved requirement adds a reproducible local or CI Lean kernel-verification pipeline and defines a formal receipt schema.

consequences: Downstream validators and VerificationBanner.vue consume deterministic, timestamp-free JSON with build_status='unverified-locally', challenge_sorry_count=5 across root Challenge.lean and null legacy verification digests on condensed main@41c2716658c4 (switching banner links via repo-layout='condensed' vs 'legacy').
Introducing verified local or CI Lean kernel receipts requires a later approved requirement revision that extends BuildStatus and the audit schema.
context: Phase 0 emits machine-generated audit JSON committed in the repository for downstream validators and the public site banner without running Lean locally; after upstream condensed onto main@41c2716658c4 (moving Challenge.lean to repo root, removing comparator/ and verification/, and introducing enable_nanoda in root comparator.json), the pipeline had to support both condensed and legacy layouts while keeping epistemic status honest and regeneration byte-identical.
decider: Developer (rulings RH-D07 approving RH-R02@v1 and RH-D16 approving RH-R07@v1)
